categories.finding: 18 isolated shape/precision cases and six custom networks cover explicit full-tile forward/dX/dW GEMMs. Arbitrary alpha/beta, strides and tails remain absent.
categories.scope_note: Kernel configurations are not independent model replications; shared-runtime coverage is not native OA implementation.

categories.finding: Three transformer configurations include per-head QK/PV products and backward. The admitted OA tensor-only route uses shared Torch softmax/masking; this is not a fused native SDPA kernel.
categories.scope_note: Kernel configurations are not independent model replications; shared-runtime coverage is not native OA implementation.

categories.finding: Residual add and gated multiply are isolated native functions. Tensor candidates cover bias/residual/ReLU. Whole bias/residual/scale are shared CUDA operations.
categories.scope_note: Kernel configurations are not independent model replications; shared-runtime coverage is not native OA implementation.

categories.finding: Forward/backward isolated functions pass. Native-all-operator wide MLP passes post-trajectory gate; small native-all-operator MLP fails it. Tensor-only routes retain shared Torch ReLU.
categories.scope_note: Kernel configurations are not independent model replications; shared-runtime coverage is not native OA implementation.

categories.finding: GELU forward passes isolated gates. Ten backward configurations fail the declared mathematical gate in both OA and ptxas; their timings are excluded. Native-all-operator transformer routes fail whole-state gates.
categories.scope_note: Kernel configurations are not independent model replications; shared-runtime coverage is not native OA implementation.

categories.finding: Isolated expressions pass. Native-all-operator gated network fails initial output gate; the OA tensor-only variant with shared Torch surrounding operations passes whole-state gates.
categories.scope_note: Kernel configurations are not independent model replications; shared-runtime coverage is not native OA implementation.

categories.finding: Complete finite FP32 rows and derivatives are tested. Native-all-operator transformer state admission fails; tensor-only models use shared Torch softmax.
categories.scope_note: Kernel configurations are not independent model replications; shared-runtime coverage is not native OA implementation.

categories.finding: Only non-affine output and dX are covered; no native saved-statistics API or dGamma/dBeta implementation, and this whole cohort uses RMSNorm instead.
categories.scope_note: Kernel configurations are not independent model replications; shared-runtime coverage is not native OA implementation.

categories.finding: Isolated output/dX pass. Native-all-operator model routes generally fail state gates; successful tensor-only models share Torch RMSNorm and affine gradients. Failures do not isolate RMSNorm as the root cause.
categories.scope_note: Kernel configurations are not independent model replications; shared-runtime coverage is not native OA implementation.

categories.finding: Bias-gradient reductions execute through shared Torch autograd in all whole methods; no new native reduction implementation.
categories.scope_note: Kernel configurations are not independent model replications; shared-runtime coverage is not native OA implementation.

categories.finding: MLPs include shared Torch MSE and its full derivative inside the whole timing boundary.
categories.scope_note: Kernel configurations are not independent model replications; shared-runtime coverage is not native OA implementation.

categories.finding: Native isolated kernel uses fixed label zero and per-row loss plus unaveraged gradient. Whole transformer mean cross-entropy/labels/backward remain shared Torch.
categories.scope_note: Kernel configurations are not independent model replications; shared-runtime coverage is not native OA implementation.

categories.finding: Fixed global-norm clipping is timed; raw and clipped gradients are checked separately. No native clipping implementation is claimed.
categories.scope_note: Kernel configurations are not independent model replications; shared-runtime coverage is not native OA implementation.

categories.finding: Native isolated Adam-like update lacks bias correction/decay. True AdamW lr1e-4, eps1e-8, decay.01, moments and step counters execute through shared Torch and are checked in whole workloads.
categories.scope_note: Kernel configurations are not independent model replications; shared-runtime coverage is not native OA implementation.

categories.finding: Isolated momentum/parameter update only, with no Nesterov, dampening, decay or full optimizer integration claim.
categories.scope_note: Kernel configurations are not independent model replications; shared-runtime coverage is not native OA implementation.

categories.finding: Division/rsqrt and composed exp/tanh/sqrt expressions have bounded finite inputs and declared tolerances. No exhaustive exceptional-value/precision-contract claim.
categories.scope_note: Kernel configurations are not independent model replications; shared-runtime coverage is not native OA implementation.

categories.finding: Exact unsigned quotient/remainder for divisor7 includes structured boundary patterns. This round does not exhaust every divisor, signed mode or address expression.
categories.scope_note: Kernel configurations are not independent model replications; shared-runtime coverage is not native OA implementation.

categories.finding: FP16 operand casts, transposed contiguous packing and head split/merge are present in whole latency. New native packing/cast implementations are absent.
categories.scope_note: Kernel configurations are not independent model replications; shared-runtime coverage is not native OA implementation.

categories.finding: Isolated native paired rotations use supplied cosine/sine arrays. Whole models use learned positions and shared CUDA finite causal masking; no integrated native RoPE/position convention claim.
categories.scope_note: Kernel configurations are not independent model replications; shared-runtime coverage is not native OA implementation.

categories.finding: Whole transformer embeddings/position gradients execute through shared Torch; no native gather/scatter atomic implementation.
categories.scope_note: Kernel configurations are not independent model replications; shared-runtime coverage is not native OA implementation.

categories.finding: Native test multiplies an externally supplied mask and fixed scale. No RNG, dropout layer or saved-mask training integration; whole models disable dropout.
categories.scope_note: Kernel configurations are not independent model replications; shared-runtime coverage is not native OA implementation.

categories.finding: No CNN convolution/pooling tests or native implementation in this round.
categories.scope_note: Kernel configurations are not independent model replications; shared-runtime coverage is not native OA implementation.

categories.finding: Single-GPU only; no actual multi-GPU collective/communication overlap experiment.
